answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Reaching the glacier of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A trellis of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ripple of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
